integrity: Topological equivalence and first-countability obstruction proved directly; explicit countable Hausdorff example constructed. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: The free-ultrafilter example assumes ZFC; no ZF-only existence or full modal completeness theorem is claimed. The Boolean finite checker verifies a lemma, not the infinite topology. Equivalent earlier Stone-dual reformulations remain possible.
title: Ultrafilter boundary for conjunction-preserving \(\omega\)-accumulation
